debrief db-021
1) The actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the c-a-p-t-i-v-e-b-r-e-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s and l-e-f-t a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-n-e-t-i-c v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) They f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d the o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y and l-e-f-t a d-i-s-c-o-n-t-i-n-u-i-t-y in the t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-h-a-i-n w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-t-e-r-i-n-a-r-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
3) The p-a-r-t-y f-o-r-g-e-d the w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e t-r-a-d-e p-e-r-m-i-t-s and l-e-f-t a f-o-r-g-e-d o-f-f-i-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) They p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d the o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s and l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-e a-d-v-e-r-t-i-s-e-m-e-n-t t-r-a-i-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) The i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e and l-e-f-t a c-r-i-m-i-n-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d of i-l-l-e-g-a-l w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e t-r-a-d-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
